title: Give your own life attention.
criticalLine: Understand what shapes you. Transcend your culture.
loveDefinition: Love is the condition in which Fear no longer governs you.

culture.title: What shapes the way you see?
culture.critique: Someone replies ‘Okay.’ Your chest tightens. It sounds dismissive. You answer sharply, and the conversation changes. A few words have met a body, a history, and an expectation.
culture.questions: Family, culture, and past encounters help shape what a new moment means. A culture that measures people by productivity can become a fear of falling behind; an old argument can make a new question feel like an attack.
culture.challenge: What are you bringing to this moment—and what will you carry from it?
culture.loveLabel: A school of thought. A way of life.
culture.loveIntro: Digital Organism Theory (DOT) asks how experience changes us, and how we can take responsibility for that change. Its proposed direction is Love.
culture.reflection: The inquiry begins with your own experience: what you feel, how you understand it, and how you respond. These ideas often become clearer in conversation, with room for questions, disagreement, and time.
